text:
Jules (CSM): Heads-up: BlueHarbor (trial customer) requested a QBR-style spend sanity check next week. Major ask: clear 90-day token forecast + a short remediation plan they can apply before renewal. They mentioned "surprise embed bills" and want per-route visibility. Can FinOps + Analytics run a conservative/likely/uptick model and include an example automated guardrail? cc @Diego @Priya
Diego (FinOps): Yep. I'll produce billed-token scenarios and a quick $ delta. Question: include savings plan scenarios (e.g., reserved throughput vs on-demand)? I can add a note but will focus on immediate mitigations first.
Priya (Analytics): Query I'll run: ```WITH u AS (SELECT day, route, SUM(tokens) tokens FROM requests WHERE account = 'blueharbor' GROUP BY day, route) SELECT day, route, tokens FROM u ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 180;``` will break out route-level trends and per-route 95th pct.
Ravi (AE): For context - they enabled semantic embeddings for search + a nightly content reindex job. Reindex runs full-pass and coincided with two large days. They're at ~65% onboarding. Renewal in 48 days.
Leah (Enablement): I can put together a 20-min "Embed cost triage" lab: how to enable prefix caching, set per-route quotas, and use our SDK batching. Also include a copy-paste alert webhook (Slack + PagerDuty) and a config snippet.
infra-bot: [system] Scheduled job detected: blueharbor->reindex-full at 2026-04-02T02:00Z (recurs daily).
alerts-bot: [automated] Anomaly: account=blueharbor, 3-day avg tokens jumped from 28k -> 110k (detected 2026-04-03). Thresholds: per-route baseline + 2x.
Jules (CSM): Great. Diego: please output the three scenarios as rows: conservative (stabilize after reindex), likely (current cadence), spike (heavy adoption). Include tokens/day and billed $ using unit $0.00042/token and add monthlyized projection.
Diego (FinOps): Will do. I'll also add an "auto-throttle ceiling" suggestion: if daily tokens > baseline*2.5 then apply active throttling to non-critical routes and send webhook to ops.
Priya (Analytics): Uploaded forecast CSV: https://files.redwood/blueharbor-90d-forecast.csv. Quick notes: median route "search-embed" = 18k/day; reindex contributed two >150k days; 95th pct for search-embed = 52k/day.
Ravi (AE): Confirmed reindex was kicked by their ingestion service. I'll ask their infra lead to add a windowed reindex or incremental re-sync. That should reduce immediate tail.
Leah (Enablement): Draft alert snippet (for playbook): ```POST /webhooks/ops
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "account":"blueharbor",
  "event":"token_spike",
  "avg_24h": {{avg_24h}},
  "baseline": {{baseline}}
}``` Also example rule for dashboard: "if route(search-embed).p95 > baseline*2 then notify('#cs-cost') and apply rate_limit(75%) on route=search-embed".
Jules (CSM): Also capture feedback items: they asked for (1) per-route token dashboards, (2) invoice line-item mapping to routes, (3) playbook we can run during onboarding to avoid surprises.
Priya (Analytics): Adding a compact chart to the CSV: 90-day rolling median + p95 per route + reconstructed baseline calc. That will be in the payload.
Diego (FinOps): For the one-pager I'll include three-line items: immediate ops asks (stagger reindex, set per-route quota), short-term product mitigation (trial v2-embed-quant on 10% traffic), and finance proposal (cap + invoice alert with credit hold if >x% over forecast).
Ravi (AE): I'll coordinate with customer to accept a short maintenance window for reindex and to sign up for the enablement lab.
Leah (Enablement): Proposed lab time Wed 11am PT. I'll prepare a 1-pager with step-by-step configs and a runnable SDK snippet that toggles batching / cache TTL.
alerts-bot: Next summary scheduled at 15:30 PT with updated route-level metrics.
Jules (CSM): Can we meet 16:00 PT today to finalize the 1-pager and the deck? Aim to have the CSV + playbook + alert rule examples ready before then.
Diego (FinOps): 16:00 PT works. I'll share the USB-friendly forecast table (3 rows + sensitivity column).
Priya (Analytics): I'll join and bring the charts. Uploaded quick screenshot to the thread: https://files.redwood/screenshot-blueharbor-forecast.png
Jules (CSM): Perfect. Goal: give customer a predictable bill path and a short checklist they can run during their onboarding week to avoid future surprises. Thanks all :rocket:
